device.description: 12-bit 40 kSPS low-power sampling ADC with internal reference and serial interface
device.note: ads7812.pdf (SBAS042A) p.2 specifications (conversion time), p.3 VIH and VS 4.75-5.25 V, p.4 pin descriptions, pin configuration and Table I input ranges, p.8 basic operation, Table II timing and Figure 2, p.9 reading data (BTC), Table III, Figures 3-4, p.10 internal/external DATACLK and Figures 5-6, p.11 Figures 7-8

pages: p.2 (conversion time 20 us max), p.3 (VIH 2.0 V to VS+0.3 V, VS 4.75-5.25 V), p.4 (pins: DIP and SOIC share one pinout; Table I ranges), p.8 (Table II: t6 BUSY low 20 us max, t20 DATACLK rising to DATA valid 85 ns max, t26/t27 CS to outputs enabled/disabled 85 ns; CONV falling starts a conversion regardless of CS), p.9 (BTC output, Table III: 0 V = 000h on +/-10 V), p.10 (external DATACLK: transmission starts on a DATACLK rising edge, each bit valid on the falling edge; DATA low after the 12th bit)
notModeled: analog inputs, input-range resistor network (R1IN/R2IN/R3IN wiring), internal reference (REF), BUF reference buffer output, CAP
codeFormat: two's complement; 0 V is 000h on the bipolar ranges (+/-10 V, Figure 1). On unipolar ranges 0 V is -full scale (800h), which the model does not give

only the external DATACLK mode (EXT/INT high) is modeled, as SPI mode 1 framed by CS: the MSB is driven after the first DATACLK rising edge, valid on the falling edge; DATA goes low after the 12th bit. The internal-DATACLK mode (EXT/INT low: the part drives 12 DATACLK pulses during the next conversion with the previous result) is not modeled; DATACLK is never driven

the output shift register is loaded just before BUSY rises and is shifted by DATACLK regardless of CS falling (the model restarts the word at each CS fall); the result is lost if DATACLK is high with CS low at that moment
BUSY is tri-stated while CS is high (the model drives it always)
PWRD power-down (and its recovery time) is not read; CONV-high time before a conversion (t5 2 us), acquisition time, 40 kHz throughput
variants: ADS7812P/U are the standard grades of the same part (same spec).
